value.rationale: The originating 2026 paper displays a first F2 example of a natural, maximal-automorphism ordinary genus-nine family but leaves its arithmetic zeta unknown. Full zeta is the canonical invariant controlling every extension-field point count and the F2 Jacobian isogeny class. Its nontrivial 2+2+2+4+8 degree decomposition and #Jac(F2)=1024 give concrete, reusable arithmetic information beyond genus, ordinarity, automorphism groups or a few sample counts. The finite cutoff is forced naturally by genus nine and Weil reciprocity, rather than chosen arbitrarily.
